content:
## Task
Improve the post-route quality of `popcount32` (32-bit registered population count of a) without changing its behavior.

## Specification (current RTL, also the equivalence reference)
```verilog
module popcount32 (
    input wire clk,
    input wire rst_n,
    input wire valid_i,
    input wire [31:0] a_i,
    input wire [31:0] b_i,
    output reg valid_o,
    output reg [5:0] y_o
);

wire [5:0] pc_0 = 6'd0 + {5'd0, a_i[0]} + {5'd0, a_i[1]} + {5'd0, a_i[2]} + {5'd0, a_i[3]} + {5'd0, a_i[4]} + {5'd0, a_i[5]} + {5'd0, a_i[6]} + {5'd0, a_i[7]} + {5'd0, a_i[8]} + {5'd0, a_i[9]} + {5'd0, a_i[10]} + {5'd0, a_i[11]} + {5'd0, a_i[12]} + {5'd0, a_i[13]} + {5'd0, a_i[14]} + {5'd0, a_i[15]} + {5'd0, a_i[16]} + {5'd0, a_i[17]} + {5'd0, a_i[18]} + {5'd0, a_i[19]} + {5'd0, a_i[20]} + {5'd0, a_i[21]} + {5'd0, a_i[22]} + {5'd0, a_i[23]} + {5'd0, a_i[24]} + {5'd0, a_i[25]} + {5'd0, a_i[26]} + {5'd0, a_i[27]} + {5'd0, a_i[28]} + {5'd0, a_i[29]} + {5'd0, a_i[30]} + {5'd0, a_i[31]};

wire [5:0] total_0 = pc_0;

always @(posedge clk) begin
    if (!rst_n) begin
        valid_o <= 1'b0;
        y_o <= 6'd0;
    end else begin
        valid_o <= valid_i;
        if (valid_i)
            y_o <= total_0;
    end
end
endmodule
```
Your design must be cycle-for-cycle equivalent to this module from reset: same ports, synchronous active-low reset, `valid_o` follows `valid_i` one cycle later, and `y_o` updates only on valid cycles and holds otherwise.

## Flow and objective
Yosys/ABC synthesis to the Nangate45 library, then OpenROAD placement, clock tree synthesis and routing with a 10 ns clock and a fixed floorplan. Score = 10 * WNS_ns - 0.001 * area_um2, where WNS is the worst setup slack after routing and area is total standard-cell area. Higher is better.

This RTL measured: area 264.67 um^2, WNS 7.01636 ns, score 69.89893.
estimate_ppa on this RTL returns area 198.436 um^2, WNS 7.09149 ns, estimated score 70.716464 (estimates omit tap cells, buffering and wiring, so compare estimates with estimates).

## Rules
- One module of synthesizable Verilog-2005 (no helper modules or instances; the equivalence checker compares flat modules). The module name and ports must not change.
- No initial blocks, system tasks, compiler directives or technology cells.
- place_and_route budget: 4 submissions. Every submission counts, including failed ones.
- At most 30 tool calls in total.

Tools available: simulate, prove_equivalence, estimate_ppa, place_and_route, finish. Your score is the best verified place_and_route score. Call finish when you are done.

content.text: I'll try two restructured implementations and compare estimates.
Let me try a carefully depth-scheduled Dadda tree with late-input-aware full adders and a lookahead final CPA.
Both carry encodings give identical results — ABC fully re-synthesizes, so only the decomposition structure matters. Let me sample two more structures.
Variant B (Wallace) is still the best. Let me verify it formally and by simulation before spending P&R budget.

content.text: V5 (minimal-FA, depth-scheduled tree) estimates best yet. Verifying it and testing a flattened-carry tail.
Let me test one more genuinely different topology (4-bit leaves + column-wise reduction) before deciding on the final submission.

V10 lands at 7.200/237 µm² — worse than V5 (7.242/178.5). V5 remains the best design and is already banked at **71.574** (baseline 69.899). No remaining candidate beats its estimate, so further P&R spending isn't justified.

input.summary: Starting from the reference (a 32-term linear adder chain: area 264.7 µm², WNS 7.016 ns, score 69.899), I established that the score is completely timing-dominated (10·WNS vs 0.001·area) and that a zero-logic probe caps WNS at ~7.86 ns, i.e. only ~0.8 ns of combinational popcount delay is available to optimize. Calibration probes (parity tree, small popcounts) gave ~0.03–0.05 ns per logic level. I then benchmarked many structurally different implementations with the cheap estimator: balanced +-tree (7.091), explicit gate-level ripple tree (7.118), 4×popcount8 + column CSA (7.123), 8×popcount4 + column reduction (7.200), a depth-scheduled Dadda with lookahead CPA (7.158), and Wallace-style carry-save trees (7.226–7.242). A/B tests showed ABC fully renormalizes local gate forms (identical results for (x&y)|((x|y)&z) vs (x&y)|((x^y)&z)), so only the global decomposition matters. The winner (V5) is a hand-scheduled carry-save tree using exactly 26 full adders (the theoretical minimum for 32→6) plus 5 half adders, with late-arriving bits deliberately placed on the "z" input of each adder and the two leftover bits folded into a level-2 FA, ending in a short 1-level-per-column carry ripple. It was formally proven equivalent and simulated clean, and post-route it gives area 246.8 µm², WNS 7.182 ns, score 71.574 (+1.675 over baseline) with fewer cells (222) than the original. Three P&R submissions were used, each an improvement (71.417 → 71.452 → 71.574); no remaining candidate beat V5's pre-route estimate, so I stopped.
